## Gorvokk (CR 13)

This enormous, apelike beast has shaggy fur and a vicious underbite. Its arms end with three claws, two of them as large and sharp as any greatsword. The creature lets out an earth-shaking roar and pounds its massive chest, ready for combat.  


**XP** 25,600  
N Huge magical beast  
**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +18  


**Defense**


**AC** 30, touch 11, flat-footed 27 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +19 natural, –2 size)  
**hp** 175 (13d10+104)  
**Fort** +16, **Ref** +10, **Will** +9  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., climb 20 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +24 (4d6+12/19-20), bite +23 (2d8+12)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** armor-piercing claws, rend (2 claws, 4d6+24), terrifying roar  


**Statistics**


**Str** 34, **Dex** 15, **Con** 26, **Int** 3, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +27; **CMD** 40  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Critical (claws), Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (claws), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Climb +24, Perception +18  
**Languages** Common (can’t speak)  


**Special Abilities**


**Armor-Piercing Claws (Ex)** Claw attacks of a gorvokk ignore hardness and damage reduction. When attacking with its claws, a gorvokk treats its opponent’s armor and natural armor bonuses as 50% lower (rounded down, so a +9 armor bonus would become a +4 armor bonus).  

**Terrifying Roar (Su)** The terrifying roar of the gorvokk unnerves even the bravest souls. When a gorvokk roars (a standard action the creature can perform at will), all hearing creatures within a 300-foot spread must succeed on a DC 24 Will save or become panicked for 2d6 rounds and shaken for 1d10 minutes thereafter. Whether or not the save is successful, creatures in the area are immune to the roar of that gorvokk for 24 hours. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect. The save DC is Constitution-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm hills  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or family (3-6)  
**Treasure** incidental
